email.subject: Iron Tide Fitness: two quick site issues
email.body:
Jack,

Looked at Iron Tide Fitness's site. Two things are likely costing you members: it's not set up for mobile, so anyone checking you out on their phone (most people) gets a broken layout and probably leaves; and there's nowhere showing reviews, so new visitors have no quick proof you're legit before they call.

Both are fixable for a flat fee, no retainer.

Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what I'd fix and why. No pitch, just a screen share.

Worth a quick look?

Alex
Northlight Web
